notes.shape: The paraphrase-styled-never-copied distractor, and the hardest negative in the set. It is written in the same flat declarative register as a vendor reference page, on a subject the supplied source page also documents (pools, sizing, draining), and a nomination pass biased for recall should and does propose it.
notes.carve_outs: Owned content applies. The discriminator is direction, and the question is whether this passage could have been written without the source in hand. It could: three named pools, six agents, two agents at sixty-four gigabytes, one release agent, a depth-eleven spike at push time, and a third heavy agent that made the second slower are observations of this repository's own queue. None of them exists upstream.
